name: risk.deposit_concentration

list.description: Read independently published bank-group deposit concentration records.

purpose: Inspect bank-group deposit concentration generated at each record's reportTime, retaining native full records.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native integer identity within this fixed metric.

fields.name: metricLabel
fields.meaning: Native bank-group label; may be empty and is not identity.

fields.name: reportDate
fields.meaning: Native reporting date, retained without timezone inference.

fields.name: reportTime
fields.meaning: This record's independent calculation time; records may differ.

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Native reported indicator value, including zero.

fields.name: balanceByUsd
fields.meaning: Native bank-group aggregate deposit amount; retained as supplied.

identity_description: Native integer id identifies a record within this fixed tenant and metric.
limitations: One fixed inquiry for tenant GUAPW3SG and metric CONCENTRATION_RATE; no public metric selector, Get, date/history selector or pagination request.
Coverage is the owner-confirmed published metric-result collection, not all banks, uncomputed records or all historical times. Native total remains unknown; observed counts are separate.
Each record has its own reportTime. The two metrics calculate independently; records within one response can also have different times. No latest selection or timestamp alignment is performed.
All native fields, nested children, types, zero values, empty labels and array order are preserved. No UI zero filtering or sorting is applied.
Complete nonempty refresh publishes only this leaf's cache; failed, empty or incomplete refresh preserves the prior capture. Live does not publish and no external Duckdog import is performed.
